row.Selected-grade rationale: Documented commercial formulation; traceable manufacturer evidence Identified on 2026-09-28 (m223-what-the-makers-say-it-is), under PLA family, polymer not stated: PLA-based, with a copolyester, "Biodegradable batch based on PLA, contains copolyester and additives." (D-EXTRUDR-GREENTEC-PRO-MSDS-EN-2019, p. 1). Extrudr's 2019 safety data sheet: PLA-based with a copolyester. Its current edition says only "bio-copolyester" (D-EXTRUDR-GREENTEC-PRO-MSDS-EN). A study with material Extrudr supplied (Burkhardt et al., Sci. Rep. 12, 20341, 2022) reports it as PLA, PBAT and PHA with a mineral filler, and its glass transition near 60 °C is PLA's. Read by an AI agent (claude-opus-5.5), not a person.
